plants.name: Paeonia lactiflora
plants.description: A long-lived herbaceous perennial with large, fragrant, often double blooms held above deep green, glossy foliage. Late-blooming varieties are at their peak in cooler northern gardens around mid-June.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late spring to early summer (May to June)
plants.location: Native to Siberia, Mongolia and northern China; widely cultivated in temperate gardens of North America and Europe
plants.funFact: Peonies can live and bloom for over 100 years, and ants visiting the buds are harmless; they simply feed on the sugary nectar on the bud surface.

plants.name: Lavandula angustifolia
plants.description: An aromatic evergreen shrub with silvery-gray, narrow leaves and spikes of small tubular flowers. In the Mediterranean and southern Europe, blooming begins in earnest in June, attracting bees and butterflies.
plants.bloomingSeason: Early to late summer (June to August)
plants.location: Native to the western Mediterranean; cultivated in Provence (France), England, Tasmania and the Pacific Northwest of the USA
plants.funFact: The name comes from the Latin 'lavare' meaning 'to wash', as the Romans used lavender to scent their baths.

plants.name: Jacaranda mimosifolia
plants.description: A tall, graceful tree with fern-like leaves that erupts into clouds of trumpet-shaped lavender-blue flowers. In the Southern Hemisphere it is not in bloom in June, but in the Northern Hemisphere subtropics, such as parts of Mexico, Florida and southern California, it blooms in late spring to early summer, carpeting streets with fallen flowers.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late spring to early summer in the Northern Hemisphere (May to June)
plants.location: Native to South America; planted in subtropical regions of the Americas, Africa, Asia and Australia, including Pretoria, South Africa, and Los Angeles, USA
plants.funFact: In Pretoria, nicknamed the 'Jacaranda City', thousands of trees line the streets, though there they bloom in October and November.

plants.name: Nymphaea alba
plants.description: A hardy aquatic perennial with round floating pads and star-shaped, many-petaled white flowers with golden centers. The blossoms open in the morning and close in the afternoon on still ponds, lakes and slow rivers.
plants.bloomingSeason: Early summer to late summer (June to August)
plants.location: Native to Europe, North Africa and parts of western Asia; found in lakes and ponds in temperate regions
plants.funFact: The flower stalks lengthen and later coil to pull the seed pod underwater, where the seeds ripen.

plants.name: Telopea speciosissima
plants.description: A striking Australian shrub bearing large, dome-shaped crimson flower heads surrounded by showy bracts. It generally blooms in spring, but in some cooler or higher locations flowering extends later, and plants in the southern hemisphere winter are mostly dormant.
plants.bloomingSeason: Spring (September to November), so not typically blooming in June in its home range
plants.location: Native to the sandstone ridges around Sydney, New South Wales, Australia
plants.funFact: It is the floral emblem of New South Wales, and its name 'Telopea' comes from the Greek for 'seen from afar'.
